title: Database Administrator
company: GVK Emergency Management and Research Institute (GVK EMRI)
description:
Role & responsibilities Complete management, support, fine tuning, security, maintenance and operation of Database of Dial 112. Provide a strategic database direction for the organization. Regular backup of database as defined by Police. Ensuing high availability of Dial 112 Application & Database. Troubleshooting of Dial 112 Applications and Database related issues. Cooperating with PMC and Police and furnishing data/reports as required by PMC. Any global certification in Database administration. 
 Preferred: Strong understanding of database concepts, data modeling, and normalization Proficiency in SQL and experience with one or more RDBMS platforms (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL) Experience with database monitoring and performance tuning tools Knowledge of backup, restore, recovery models, and disaster recovery planning Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Shell, PowerShell) for automation Good analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in a team and independently, including in a 24x7 environment (if required)

Key Skills: DBA,Database administration,PowerShell,RDBMS,PostgreSQL,MySQL,performance tuning tools,Oracle
